description: Remote northern airports is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Ontario | Gouvernement de l'Ontario. The Ministry of Transportation's Remote Northern Transportation Office in Thunder Bay operates 29 airports. These are located in Ontario's far north, extending from the Manitoba border on the west to Hudson's Bay on the north and to the Quebec border on the east. Coverage: Government of Ontario. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Ontario | Gouvernement de l'Ontario. Its tags are Infrastructure and Transportation, Driving and roads, Government information, Infrastructure et transport, Conduite et routes. It offers 5 resource(s) in DOCX, HTML, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-06-19 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence – Ontario. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
